compute_sampson_epipolar_distance: compute sampson epipolar distance for 2D point correspondences given batched fundamental matrices
normalize_points_masked: normalize 2D point coordinates with a boolean mask to exclude invalid points and return the transformation matrix
triangulate_point_batch: triangulate 3D points from 2D correspondences given two camera-to-world projection matrices via SVD
remove_cheirality: select the rotation and translation configuration that places the most 3D points in front of both cameras
calculate_residual_indicator: rank model candidates by combining inlier count and average inlier residual for RANSAC-style selection
